sections.overview:
daisyUI 5 is a CSS component library built for Tailwind CSS 4 that provides semantic class names for common UI components. It streamlines UI development by offering pre-designed components that integrate seamlessly with Tailwind CSS, reducing the need to write custom styles from scratch. This skill is suitable for developers who want to accelerate their design workflow while maintaining consistency across their web applications.

Enhancing existing Tailwind CSS projects with semantic UI components
